data.action: 单手持剑，剑锋斜指地面
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, sword pointed toward the scorched floor visible
data.description: 训练场中央焦黑的地面上还残留着灼烧的青烟，史尔特尔单手斜提魔剑，剑尖在合金地板上划出一道耀眼的火星。她甩开额前的汗湿碎发，向你投来好战的目光——「刚才那场演练的热身勉强合格。博士，下一个对手是谁？可别让我等太久。」
data.promptProse: Surtr lowers her sword toward the scorched floor and smirks, cool morning light catching its edge and her chains.
data.title: 史尔特尔 · 演武场
data.animaCaption: She lowers the sword toward the scorched floor and gives a small smirk.
